name: BotDolphin AI Chatbot
author: ammarali780

sections.description:
BotDolphin is an AI-powered chatbot platform that helps you automate customer support and capture leads on your WordPress website around the clock.

Key Features:

  • AI-powered conversations using GPT technology
  • 24/7 automated customer support
  • Lead capture and contact management
  • Train AI with your own content
  • Customizable chat widget appearance
  • Conversation analytics and insights

How It Works:

This plugin connects your WordPress website to the BotDolphin service. The chatbot widget is loaded from BotDolphin servers and all customization is done through the BotDolphin dashboard.

  1. Create a free account at botdolphin.com
  2. Create and customize your chatbot in the dashboard
  3. Install this plugin on your WordPress site
  4. Enter your Chatbot ID in the plugin settings
  5. Enable the chatbot – you’re done!

External Services

This plugin relies on the BotDolphin external service to provide AI chatbot functionality. The service is required for the plugin to work.

BotDolphin API Service

  • Service Provider: BotDolphin
  • Service Website: https://botdolphin.com
  • Widget Host: 30-production-9f14.up.railway.app

What data is sent and when:

  1. Widget Script Loading: When the chatbot is enabled, the plugin loads a JavaScript widget from https://30-production-9f14.up.railway.app/widget.js. This happens on every page load for your website visitors.

  2. Chatbot Configuration: Your Chatbot ID is sent to retrieve your specific chatbot settings (colors, messages, behavior).

  3. Visitor Messages: When a visitor types a message in the chat widget, the message content is sent to BotDolphin servers to generate an AI response.

  4. Lead Form Data: If you have lead capture enabled and a visitor submits their information, the following data may be collected based on your configuration:

    • Name
    • Email address
    • Phone number

  5. Page URL: The current page URL is sent for conversation context and analytics.

  6. Session Data: A unique session identifier is used to maintain conversation continuity.

YouTube (setup guide video, admin screen only)

  • Service Provider: YouTube / Google
  • Hosts: i.ytimg.com (preview image), www.youtube-nocookie.com (video player)

The plugin settings screen shows a setup guide video. The preview thumbnail is loaded from i.ytimg.com when an administrator opens the settings page. The video player is loaded from www.youtube-nocookie.com only after the administrator clicks play. This affects logged-in administrators viewing the plugin settings page only, never your website visitors.

  • YouTube Terms of Service: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Third-Party Service Links:

  • Terms of Service: https://botdolphin.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://botdolphin.com/privacy

OpenAI Integration:

BotDolphin uses OpenAI’s GPT technology to power AI responses. When visitors interact with your chatbot, their messages are processed through OpenAI’s API via BotDolphin’s servers. Please review OpenAI’s policies:

  • OpenAI Terms of Use: https://openai.com/terms
  • OpenAI Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/botdolphin-ai-chatbot/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the BotDolphin menu in your admin dashboard.
  4. Enter your Chatbot ID from app.botdolphin.com.
  5. Enable the chatbot and save settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need a BotDolphin account?

Yes, you need a free account at botdolphin.com to use this plugin.

Where do I find my Chatbot ID?

Log in to your BotDolphin Dashboard at app.botdolphin.com, select your chatbot, and go to the Install tab to find your Chatbot ID.

How do I customize the chatbot appearance?

All customization options including colors, messages, AI behavior, and lead capture settings are available in the BotDolphin dashboard.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The chat widget script loads asynchronously and does not block page rendering.

Is there a free plan?

Yes, BotDolphin offers a free trial plan. Visit botdolphin.com for pricing details.

What data does the chatbot collect?

The chatbot collects visitor messages for AI processing. If you enable lead capture, it can also collect name, email, and phone number based on your settings. See the External Services section for complete details.

Is the data secure?

Yes, all data is transmitted over HTTPS and stored securely. Please review our Privacy Policy at botdolphin.com/privacy for details.
